## Overview

WEHI CS62 long read sequencing r10.4.1 vs EPIC array vs EPICv2

WEHI CS62 long read sequencing was performed between 7th Feb and 8th Feb 2024, using nanopore long read sequencing with pore r10.4.1. The fragmentation of DNA was carried out with gTube using 15Mb protocol.

EPICv2 on WEHI CS62 was carried out as part of the DNMT1i treatment series (20230612_ScottOvCaEPIC)

EPICv1 on WEHI CS62 was generated around 2023Feb

## Aim

Aim of this document is to perform preliminary analysis for WEHI-CS62 in regards to its methylation status

```{r load file}
#|echo: False
lr <- "Me/wehi_cs62_sup_modkit_pileup_tab.bed"
epic_dir <- "../20230207_ScottMethArrays/ScottMethArray_norm_beta.csv"
epicv2_dir <- "../GSK_treated_OvCa/raw"


epic_norm_meth <- fread(epic_dir)

RGset_epicv2 <- read.metharray.exp(targets = read.metharray.sheet(epicv2_dir))

lr_meth <- fread(lr, sep = "\t")


lr_meth <- lr_meth%>%
  `colnames<-`(c("chrom", "start", "end", "mod_type", "Nvalid_cov_2", "strand", "start_2", "end_2", "color_2", "Nvalid_cov", "fraction_mod", "Nmod", "Ncanonical", "Nother_mod", "Ndelete", "Nfail", "Ndiff", "Nnocall")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-contains("_2"))
```

```{r}
lr_meth %>%

```

```{r}
#| code-fold: True
#| echo:false
Green <- getGreen(RGset_epicv2)
Red <- getRed(RGset_epicv2)

AT.controls <- getControlAddress(
            object = IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2manifest,
            controlType = c("NORM_A", "NORM_T"))
CG.controls <- getControlAddress(
            object = IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2manifest,
            controlType = c("NORM_C", "NORM_G"))

assay(RGset_epicv2, "Green") <- Green
assay(RGset_epicv2, "Red") <- Red


#manually load into methylset to access available mapping
TypeI.Red <- getProbeInfo(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2manifest, type = "I-Red")
TypeI.Green <- getProbeInfo(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2manifest, type = "I-Green")
TypeII <- getProbeInfo(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2manifest, type = "II")
locusNames <- getManifestInfo(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2manifest, "locusNames")
M_and_U <- .preprocessRaw(
        Red = Red,
        Green = Green,
        locusNames = locusNames,
        TypeI.Red = TypeI.Red,
        TypeI.Green = TypeI.Green,
        TypeII = TypeII)
M <- M_and_U[["M"]]
U <- M_and_U[["U"]]

RGset_epicv2_raw <- MethylSet(
        Meth = M,
        Unmeth = U,
        colData = colData(RGset_epicv2),
        annotation = annotation(RGset_epicv2),
        metadata = metadata(RGset_epicv2))

#normalisation
Green.avg <- colMeans2(Green, rows = match(CG.controls, rownames(Green)))
Red.avg <- colMeans2(Red, rows = match(AT.controls, rownames(Red)))
ref <- (Green.avg + Red.avg)[1] / 2
Green.factor <- ref / Green.avg
Red.factor <- ref / Red.avg
Green <- sweep(Green, 2, FUN = "*", Green.factor)
Red <- sweep(Red, 2, FUN = "*", Red.factor)

#bg.correction
NegControls <- getControlAddress(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2manifest, controlType = "NEGATIVE")
Green.bg <- apply(Green[NegControls, , drop = FALSE], 2, function(xx) {
        sort(as.vector(xx))[31]})
Red.bg <- apply(Red[NegControls, , drop = FALSE], 2, function(xx) {
        sort(as.vector(xx))[31] })
Green <- pmax2(sweep(Green, 2, Green.bg), 0)
Red <- pmax2(sweep(Red, 2, Red.bg), 0)

M_and_U <- .preprocessRaw(
        Red = Red,
        Green = Green,
        locusNames = locusNames,
        TypeI.Red = TypeI.Red,
        TypeI.Green = TypeI.Green,
        TypeII = TypeII)
M <- M_and_U[["M"]]
U <- M_and_U[["U"]]

RGset_epicv2_prep <- MethylSet(
        Meth = M,
        Unmeth = U,
        colData = colData(RGset_epicv2_raw),
        annotation = annotation(RGset_epicv2_raw),
        metadata = metadata(RGset_epicv2_raw))

rm(M, M_and_U, U, NegControls, Red, Green, Green.avg, Green.bg, Green.factor, Red.avg, Red.bg, Red.factor, TypeI.Green, TypeI.Red, TypeII, AT.controls, CG.controls)
```

Quick QC

```{r}
RGset_epicv2 <- data.frame(getBeta(RGset_epicv2_prep)) %>%
`colnames<-`(c("62_DMNT1i_T1", "62_DMNT1i_T2", "62_DMNT1i_T3", "62_DMNT1i_T4", "62_Untreated", "OVCAR8_DMNT1i", "OVCAR8_Untreated", "PH039")) %>%
  rownames_to_column("probes") %>%
  left_join(as.data.frame(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICv2anno.20a1.hg38::Locations) %>%
              rownames_to_column("probes"))


epiv2_lr <- RGset_epicv2 %>%
  left_join(lr_meth %>%
              dplyr::select(chr = 1, pos = V3, mod_type =V4, V10))
epiv2_lr <- epiv2_lr %>%
  separate(V10, sep = " ", into = c("Nvalid_cov", "fraction_mod", "Nmod", "Ncanonical", "Nother_mod", "Ndelete", "Nfail", "Ndiff", "Nnocall"))

epiv2_lr %>%
  filter(mod_type == "m") %>%
  
  mutate(Nother_mod = as.integer(Nother_mod),
         Nmod =as.integer(Nmod),
         Nvalid_cov = as.integer(Nvalid_cov),
    sum_mod_frac = (Nother_mod+ Nmod)/Nvalid_cov) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sum_mod_frac/100, y = `62_Untreated`))+
  geom_bin2d(bins = 40)+
  stat_cor(label.y = 1.1) +
  stat_regline_equation(label.y = 1.05)+scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Spectral", trans = "log2")+
  theme_bw()+
  xlab("%5mC+5hmC per CpG")+
  ylab("EPIC V2 beta")
ggsave("epicv2_vs_lr_5mc_5hmc.pdf")

epiv2_lr %>%
  filter(mod_type == "m") %>%
  mutate(fraction_mod = as.numeric(fraction_mod)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = fraction_mod/100, y = `62_Untreated`))+
  geom_bin2d(bins = 40)+
  stat_cor(label.y = 1.1) +
  stat_regline_equation(label.y = 1.05)+scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Spectral", trans = "log2")+
  theme_bw()+
  xlab("%5mC+5hmC per CpG")+
  ylab("EPIC V2 beta")

ggsave("epicv2_vs_lr_5mc_only.pdf")


epiv2_lr %>%
  filter(mod_type == "m") %>%
  
  mutate(Nother_mod = as.integer(Nother_mod),
         Nmod =as.integer(Nmod),
         Nvalid_cov = as.integer(Nvalid_cov),
    sum_mod_frac = (Nother_mod+ Nmod)/Nvalid_cov) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sum_mod_frac/100, y = `62_Untreated`))+
  geom_bin2d(bins = 40)+
  stat_cor(label.y = 1.1) +
  stat_regline_equation(label.y = 1.05)+scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Spectral", trans = "log2")+
  theme_bw()+
  xlab("%5mC+5hmC per CpG")+
  ylab("EPIC V2 beta")

```
